title: [Transform] stop transform regardless of transform nodes

timeline.body:

the cluster lacks a transform node)

fixes #69260

timeline.body:
```suggestion
     * Get nodes where (requested) transforms are executed.
```

'were' -> 'where'

Shouldn't the parentheses be different here?
```
.filter(id -> (assigned.contains(id) || waitingForAssignment.contains(id)) == false)
```

timeline.author: Hendrik Muhs

timeline.body:
Stopped transforms are the ones that don't have a task, the id is neither assigned or unassigned.

```suggestion
            .filter(id -> (assigned.contains(id) == false || waitingForAssignment.contains(id) == false))
```

reply.body: :+1: I applied @przemekwitek suggestion and moved the parentheses. There are also some more tests.

timeline.body: So, what is there left to do? Aren't waiting tasks handled by `cancelTransformTasksWithNoAssignment`?

reply.body:
this is the special case were the transform "lost" the configuration, meaning it could not be found in the transform index. This happens if you e.g. manually delete the document or the whole index. 

I still think we should handle it, but I like to postpone it to the follow up, I added the todo there.
